key_insight: A closed-loop optimizer calibrates atomistic GaAs growth kinetics directly from experimental growth data, reducing reliance on costly DFT-derived rate parameters.
engineering_relevance: The framework turns routinely measured MOCVD growth rates into mechanistic insight that could support less experiment-intensive process optimization.
method: Simulate deposition through atomistic, rate-controlled events using kinetic Monte Carlo.
Calibrate kinetic parameters against experimental growth data using Monte Carlo Tree Search.
Steer the search using each reaction parameter’s degree of rate control.
evidence_signal: For GaAs MOCVD, the calibrated model captures the measured growth rate’s temperature dependence and recovers three known kinetic regimes with changing rate-determining steps.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify predictive errors or establish generalization beyond the GaAs calibration case.
paper_title: Atomistic Insights into MOCVD Growth of GaAs using a Closed Loop Autonomous System Combining Directed Reinforcement Learning and Kinetic Monte Carlo Simulations
